newsitem.title: CHINA: Zhenhua Port opens at $0.440 in Shanghai debut.
newsitem.headline: Zhenhua Port opens at $0.440 in Shanghai debut.

text.p: China's Zhenhua Port Machinery Co Ltd's foreign currency B shares debuted on the Shanghai stock exchange on Tuesday at $0.440, compared with an offer price of $0.433.
The company, which makes port handling equipment, issued 100 million B shares in mid-July to raise net proceeds of $41.135 million.
Zhenhua Port had opened higher despite weakness in the overall B share market because investors felt the company had good growth prospects, analysts said.
"This industry (port machinery) is special and not everyone can do this kind of business," said an analyst at an Asian securities firm in Shanghai.
"This is a good company and the pricing was reasonable," he added.
Zhenhua Port has forecast its 1997 net profits at 117.239 million yuan against 77.876 million yuan in 1996 based on international accounting standards.
